record.paper_title: Conformally invariant scaling limits: an overview and a collection of problems
record.original_question: Prove an analogue of Smirnov's theorem for Voronoi percolation, turning the known conformal-invariance information for this model into a full theorem of the same type as in critical site percolation on the triangular lattice.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.12. Prove Smirnov’s theorem for Voronoi percolation.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\eta$ be a homogeneous Poisson point process of intensity $1$ in the plane $\mathbb{R}^2$, and let $\mathcal{V}(\eta) = \{V_x : x \in \eta\}$ be the associated Voronoi tessellation, where $V_x = \{y \in \mathbb{R}^2 : |y-x| \le |y-x'| \text{ for all } x' \in \eta\}$. Independently of $\eta$, color each Voronoi cell $V_x$ black with probability $1/2$ and white with probability $1/2$. This is critical planar Voronoi percolation.

For a Jordan domain $D \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ with four marked boundary prime ends $a,b,c,d$ in counterclockwise order, and for $\delta > 0$, let $f_\delta(D;a,b,c,d)$ denote the probability that, in the rescaled model on $\delta\mathbb{R}^2$ (equivalently, intensity $\delta^{-2}$), there exists a black crossing in $D$ from the boundary arc $ab$ to the boundary arc $cd$.

Prove the following analogue of Smirnov's theorem (originally established for critical site percolation on the triangular lattice):

(i) (Conformal invariance / Cardy's formula.) For every such configuration $(D;a,b,c,d)$, the limit
$$f(D;a,b,c,d) = \lim_{\delta \downarrow 0} f_\delta(D;a,b,c,d)$$
exists, is conformally invariant (i.e. $f(D;a,b,c,d) = f(\varphi(D);\varphi(a),\varphi(b),\varphi(c),\varphi(d))$ for every conformal map $\varphi$ defined on a neighborhood of $\overline{D}$), and is given by Cardy's formula: writing $(D;a,b,c,d)$ as the equilateral triangle with vertices $a,b,c$ and a marked point $d$ on the side $ca$ at signed distance $u \in [0,1]$ from $c$, one has $f = u$.

(ii) (Scaling limit / SLE$_6$.) The interface of the critical Voronoi percolation model in a Jordan domain with Dobrushin boundary conditions converges in distribution, as $\delta \downarrow 0$, to chordal Schramm–Loewner Evolution with parameter $\kappa = 6$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to remain open. Smirnov's theorem (conformal invariance, Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE_6) has been proved only for critical site percolation on the triangular lattice. For Voronoi percolation, Benjamini and Schramm established invariance of crossing probabilities under conformal changes of metric, and Bollobás–Riordan determined the critical probability to be 1/2, but no full Smirnov-type theorem (Cardy's formula and SLE_6 scaling limit) has been established for Voronoi percolation in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Conformal Invariance of Voronoi Percolation (Benjamini–Schramm)
status_evidence.snippet: Crossing probabilities for Voronoi percolation are asymptotically invariant under conformal change of metric, but a full conformal invariance / Cardy formula is not proved.
status_evidence.claim: Only a partial 'conformal change of metric' invariance is established for Voronoi percolation.

status_evidence.title: The critical probability for random Voronoi percolation in the plane is 1/2
status_evidence.snippet: Bollobás and Riordan show p_c = 1/2 for planar Voronoi percolation; conformal invariance of the scaling limit is not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Critical value known but Smirnov-type theorem not established.

status_evidence.title: Critical percolation in the plane (Smirnov)
status_evidence.snippet: Smirnov's proof of Cardy's formula and conformal invariance is given for site percolation on the triangular lattice.
status_evidence.claim: Smirnov's theorem is currently known only for the triangular lattice.
